scientific_question: Is the rejected causal hybrid's terminal loss caused primarily by a destructive c_proj endpoint direction, or does c_proj only become useful through wider MLP and block-frame co-adaptation?

scope.purpose: terminal endpoint and near-affine functional interpolation diagnosis; this does not establish the geometry of the complete training trajectory

inputs.parent_name: accepted causal c_proj hidden64+24 error-feedback decay1

evaluation.fixed_index_algorithm: examples.nanogpt.train.make_fixed_eval_indices and fixed_eval_indices_digest; both split streams are hashed although only val is evaluated
requirements: verify both checkpoint, checkpoint-metadata, result-artifact, and dataset-manifest hashes before loading CUDA
verify identical model configuration and model state key/shape topology
evaluate every variant on exactly the same ordered validation indices within each window
require finite cross entropy for every batch and variant
record per-window means and standard errors rather than pooling away window identity

interpolation.formula: W(alpha) = (1-alpha) * W_context + alpha * W_other for the selected tensor family, copied into the context model with all nonselected tensors unchanged

parameter_geometry.interpretation_limit: Two terminal checkpoints and the affine segment between them can expose endpoint direction, scale, depth localization, and functional barriers, but cannot prove a low-dimensional or near-affine training-trajectory manifold.

registered_decision_rule.native_gap_definition: for each window, CE(hybrid native) - CE(parent native)
registered_decision_rule.hybrid_context_cproj_recovery_fraction: (CE(hybrid native) - CE(hybrid context with all parent c_proj)) / native_gap
registered_decision_rule.direction_dominates: HYBRID_CPROJ_ENDPOINT_DIRECTION_DOMINATES iff the all-parent-c_proj transplant recovers at least 0.50 of the native gap in both windows and at least one alpha in {0.25,0.50,0.75,1.00} lowers hybrid-context CE in both windows
registered_decision_rule.wider_coadaptation_dominates: WIDER_BLOCK_COADAPTATION_DOMINATES iff the all-parent-c_proj transplant recovers at most 0.25 of the native gap in both windows and none of alpha {0.25,0.50,0.75} improves hybrid-context CE by at least 0.01 in both windows
registered_decision_rule.interior_barrier: INTERIOR_FUNCTIONAL_BARRIER iff at one common interior alpha, observed CE exceeds the linear interpolation of the two same-context endpoint CEs by at least 0.01 in both windows; otherwise NO_LARGE_INTERIOR_FUNCTIONAL_BARRIER

next_action_constraints.if_direction_dominates: Do not add capacity first; diagnose why the causal selector accumulates the wrong endpoint and test a transported/frozen-reference direction only after a separate preregistration.
next_action_constraints.if_wider_coadaptation_dominates: Stop treating c_proj as an isolated manifold. Study a coupled nonlinear MLP or residual-frame connection before another optimizer-coordinate variant.
next_action_constraints.if_mixed: Use depth and wider-context controls to register the smallest causal coupled structure; do not sweep the rejected task/directed widths.
